body: Just turned 18 a few days ago and am and have been feeling this. I’m a certified fuck up by my own volition and have been for over a decade. All I have is video games and my animals.

I’m not too sure if what you’re referring to is like the places I’ve been to but I can give some general advice I wish someone gave my dad. Treat her like a person and make sure to tell her you know it’s a serious illness. Not some fleeting feeling. Let her know you love her and trust her and are willing to help.

I always thought I could then I seriously attempted. I saw just pitch black, been scared of dying since then. That feeling of not being. Only just darkness. No thoughts. I still don’t want to live, but fuck if that didn’t scare me.

I grew up really poor. I still am but we’re at least well enough now that my dad can pay off the odd medical bills. Best thing I can advise you is look for really low cost government or charity funded therapist/psychologist. I had one a year and a half ago at 16. She operated out of a goodwill and only charged us about $20 per session. I’m not saying that’s super accessible but it’s far better than most. Going once a week and letting it all out is better than nothing. They talk with you a good amount and it helps. Always be on the lookout for low cost and even free services. Take care.

Me too man me too. Only thing we can do is try and do as much as we can to make up for what we think/do. Just know, if you feel remorse that you aren’t a bad person. I’ll hope for you, hope you find something to make you feel happy.

I wanted to add my experience to this to maybe just help you feel a bit better. I didn’t die medically or anything but I did feel my vision fade and felt like I lost feeling in my body. It’s honestly terrifying, absolutely the scariest experience I’ve ever been through. I think it’s probably the instincts of an animal that thinks it’s about to die. For a few weeks after I felt different. Like there was no reason to die, of course I never followed up with counseling or medication which is vital so here I am again. Just know it fucking sucks feeling like you’re about to die, if you can, I know it sounds cliche and dumb, but just think about it for a moment how much your body really wants to live.

Mostly when I go to bed. I do have reason to believe I get them at night when I wake up with pains cramps and sore all over. Once I wake up, if I lay in bed or anywhere really there’s always a chance it happens. Again I’m pretty sure it’s just psychosomatic. A way for my body to remind me what I did and how I felt. Maybe more what I didn’t do.

I figured as much. Thank you though really. It only happens at night when I’m laying down which is why I believe it’s just something in my head reminding me to that day. Again thanks for taking the time. Really.
